$comment: Shared parity fixtures for bidder registration, per docs/server-validation.md §9.
The client validators (js/register.js today, a React form later) and the server
rules WILL drift unless something forces them not to. Both must run these cases.
A case passing one and failing the other is a build failure.
Seeded from the adversarial matrix in the spec. 'expectedCodes' is the exact set
of error codes expected — an empty array means the input must be accepted.
Codes are never prose: the API is locale-agnostic and the client owns the copy.

mustAccept.name: cyrillic local part and IDN-ish domain
mustAccept.why: An ASCII-only email pattern is a guaranteed defect on a Bulgarian site.

mustAccept.name: apostrophe and hyphen across scripts
mustAccept.why: \p{L} rather than [A-Za-z]; also covers non-Bulgarian bidders.

mustAccept.name: sofia landline with spaces
mustAccept.why: Leading 0 is the trunk prefix. Normalisation runs before validation.

mustAccept.name: plovdiv landline already in E.164
mustAccept.why: BG landlines vary in length; 7-8 subscriber digits must both pass.

mustAccept.name: double-zero international prefix
mustAccept.why: 00 is the international prefix and must map to +.

mustAccept.name: foreign number
mustAccept.why: Foreign bidders exist. Real verification is possession via OTP.

mustAccept.name: 64-character passphrase with spaces
mustAccept.value: correct horse battery staple correct horse battery staple abcdef
mustAccept.why: NIST: >=64 must be accepted, spaces are legal, no composition rules.

mustAccept.name: 18th birthday is today
mustAccept.why: The case naive UTC arithmetic gets wrong. Must succeed.

mustAccept.name: marketing declined still registers
mustAccept.why: Marketing consent must never gate account creation.

mustReject.name: impossible calendar date
mustReject.why: Round-tripping through Date catches what a regex cannot.

mustReject.name: EIK with transposed digits
mustReject.why: Transposition is the commonest typo and exactly what mod-11 catches.

mustReject.name: bidi override in a name
mustReject.why: U+202E reverses rendering; what is displayed is not what is stored.

mustReject.name: terms as a string rather than boolean true
mustReject.why: Truthiness is not consent. Only boolean true counts.

mustReject.name: password containing the email local part
non-empty honeypot
mustReject.why: Returns 202 and is silently discarded. Never reveal the trap.

mustReject.name: email without a dot in the domain
